title: Draft: MP2T, GSE: conversation-based reassembly
description:
Use the conversation based reassembly with MPEG 2 TS and GSE. This
makes it possible to correctly reassembly MP2T occuring on DVB-S2
with multiple streams without.

It also addresses some reassembly issues in MP2T where a capture contains
multiple UDP or RTP conversations with transport streams, but some of
those TS have MPE which changes the addresses and ports as subdissectors
are called. This assures that fragments are put on the correct
reassembly.

notes.body:
This a draft because it depends on !3406 / includes the commit from that merge request. (I believe that explicit dependencies are a paid Gitlab option.) [mpe_fragments.pcapng](/uploads/b068dac17d223e17206db9de831da05e/mpe_fragments.pcapng) is an example of a capture that currently has reassembly issues; e.g. the last TS packet in packet 3 (CC=8) should be reassembled with the first TS packet in packet 4 (CC=9), but they are not because the reassembled MPE in packet 3 changes the addresses and ports.

Just using a single "no address" type for MP2T and the addresses only table wouldn't work in cases where a file has multiple separate transport streams (not just one TS with multiple PIDs.)
changed title from **Draft: {-stream-}: conversation-based reassembly** to **Draft: {+MP2T, GSE+}: conversation-based reassembly**

commits_data.title: stream: conversation-based reassembly
commits_data.message:
stream: conversation-based reassembly

Add reassembly functions that take a conversation_t as the data
parameter and use it, along with direction and a fragment ID, for
the reassembly hash but do not use addresses or ports from packet_info.

Use these functions with the stream API, where they fit the existing
stream keys. Make them available in the reassembly API for use with
other protocols which are endpoint based, particularly those containing
subpackets which can overwrite the addresses in pinfo (e.g. DVB with GSE
and MPE).
